description:
**JD: AI Solutions Consultant (US Market Only)**

DigiLantern is a Technology company specializing in Application development, AI, and SalesForce Solutions. We provide Digital transformation solutions to our mid-size and enterprise clients. We cater to clients across different industries in North America and are expanding our team with a focus on the US markets.

* Location:Noida
* Job Type:full-Time | On-site
* Experience:3+ Years
* Working Days:5 Days a Week
* Profile: AI Solutions Consultant (US Market Only)

**Work Structure (Important)**

This role follows a hybrid schedule aligned with US business hours:

* 12 PM – 4 PM: Mandatory Work from Office for internal coordination, team discussions, and project alignment
* 8 PM onwards: Work from Home for US client meetings and project management activities

**Please apply only if you are comfortable with this work structure and timings, it's not a Remote role, one needs to be available in the Office daily.**

**Interview Process**

* Round 1: Virtual Discussion over Zoom
* Final Round: Face-to-Face Discussion at our Noida Office

**About DigiLantern**

DigiLantern is a technology company delivering AI Solutions, AI Agents, AI Chatbots, Application Development, and CRM Solutions for North American businesses.

We help organizations leverage AI and technology to improve operational efficiency, automate workflows, and build scalable digital solutions.

Website: (http://www.digilantern.com)

**About the Role**

We are hiring an AI Solutions Partner to work at the intersection of business and AI delivery.

In this role, you will work directly with clients to understand business challenges, shape practical AI-driven solutions, and drive those solutions through execution alongside internal teams.

**This is a client-facing solutioning and delivery role, not a coding or software development position.** While hands-on development is not required, the role demands a strong understanding of AI tools, applications, and workflows to effectively scope solutions, communicate with stakeholders, and ensure successful delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* **Work directly with clients, especially US-based stakeholders, to understand business challenges and translate them into practical AI-driven solutions**

\* Lead solutioning discussions by defining scope, approach, and expected outcomes

\* Own projects from discovery and planning through delivery and client communication

\* Collaborate with internal technical and delivery teams to ensure smooth execution and alignment

\* Conduct R&D on emerging AI tools, trends, automation workflows, and market opportunities

\* Identify areas where AI and process improvements can create measurable business impact

\* Contribute strategic ideas and innovative approaches aligned with client and business goals

\* Maintain strong communication and stakeholder management throughout project lifecycles

**What We’re Looking For**

\* Strong business acumen with the ability to understand operational and strategic business challenges

\* Good understanding of AI tools, LLMs, automation workflows, and emerging AI applications

\* Strong solutioning and problem-solving capabilities

\* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

\* Experience working with international clients, preferably US-based clients

\* Self-driven and capable of independently managing projects and responsibilities

\* Strong research orientation with genuine interest in AI and innovation

\* Ability to balance business thinking with technology understanding

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

\* Business-first mindset with strong technology awareness

\* Confident and professional communicator

\* Research-oriented and innovation-driven

\* Structured, execution-focused, and proactive

\* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international client environment

\* A go-getter with strong ownership and accountability mindset

title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor-VDI
description:
**Req ID:** 385267
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor-VDI to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description
  
  
The VDI Systems Integration Principal Advisor is a recognized subject matter expert and technical leader with extensive experience designing, transforming, and optimizing complex enterprise end-user computing and virtualization environments. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, enabling the Principal Advisor to influence technology direction, drive innovation, and deliver business value across multiple clients and organizations.
  
  
The Principal Advisor serves as the highest level of technical escalation and trusted advisor for both customers and internal stakeholders. Candidates must demonstrate advanced leadership capabilities, exceptional communication skills, and a proven ability to guide large-scale transformation initiatives while mentoring senior engineers and consultants. The ability to operate effectively in highly complex and ambiguous environments is essential.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as the highest level technical escalation point for complex support and engineering activities.
* Provide strategic technical leadership across multiple accounts, programs, and initiatives.
* Define and drive architectural standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for VDI and Application Delivery platforms.
* Lead the design, implementation, and modernization of large-scale enterprise virtualization and digital workspace solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, customers, account teams, and technology partners.
* Establish long-term roadmap strategies for Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, VMware, Windows 365, and related technologies.
* Lead technical assessments, solution reviews, risk evaluations, and architecture governance activities.
* Drive innovation through automation, AI-enabled operations, self-service capabilities, and operational optimization initiatives.
* Collaborate with leadership teams to align technology strategies with business objectives.
* Mentor senior engineers and advisors while fostering technical growth across the practice.
* Develop and maintain enterprise reference architectures, solution patterns, and technical standards.
* Lead critical incident management activities and provide executive-level communications during major service outages.
* Identify emerging technologies, assess business value, and recommend adoption strategies.
* Support pre-sales activities, solution development, proposals, and customer presentations.
* Drive operational excellence by improving service quality, stability, security, and performance.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and establish a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of large and complex transformation programs.
* Ensure compliance with Change Management, Security, Governance, and ITIL processes.
* Participate in executive reviews, architecture boards, and strategic planning sessions.
* Provide thought leadership and represent the organization in customer-facing and industry engagements.

Required Skills
  
  

* 10+ years of IT infrastructure engineering, architecture, or technical consulting experience.
* 10+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise virtualization and end-user computing solutions
* Expert-level knowledge of Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix DaaS, and related Citrix technologies (CCP/CCE certifications highly preferred).
* 7+ years of experience with Azure Virtual Desktop and cloud-native EUC platforms.
* Proven experience defining enterprise architecture strategies and technology roadmaps.
* Advanced expertise with VMware vSphere, Citrix Hypervisor, Microsoft Hyper-V, and hybrid cloud infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Azure, AWS, and enterprise cloud adoption frameworks.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking, security, identity management, Zero Trust concepts, TCP/IP, SAN, NAS, and datacenter operations.
* Expert knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Profile Management, and endpoint management solutions.
* Extensive experience with automation technologies including PowerShell, Terraform, ARM/Bicep, Azure Automation, or equivalent tools.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale infrastructure transformation and migration projects.
* Proven ability to provide executive-level technical guidance and customer-facing leadership.
* Strong consulting, architecture, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience establishing technical governance, operational standards, and engineering best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and organizations.
* Strong financial and business acumen with the ability to align technology decisions to business outcomes.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
* Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Advanced cloud certifications preferred (Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, VMware VCP/VCAP, Citrix CCE).
* Nice to have: Windows 365, AWS WorkSpaces, Nerdio, IGEL, Omnissa Horizon, ControlUp, Liquidware, Azure Landing Zones, Infrastructure as Code, AI Operations (AIOps).

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. title: Solar Structures (MMS)- Head
description:
**Head / Manager – Solar Structures (MMS)**

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Department: Solar Structures / MMS

Company: Chemi Tech Constructions Pvt. Ltd.

Experience: 5–10 years preferred

Industry: Solar MMS / Roll Forming / Structural Steel / Solar EPC

**About the Role**

Chemi Tech Constructions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and versatile professional to lead our Solar Module Mounting Structure (MMS) vertical from our Noida Head Office.

This is a cross-functional role requiring a combination of technical knowledge, design understanding, customer handling, manufacturing coordination and problem-solving ability.

The person will act as the primary technical and commercial coordinator for the MMS business and work closely with our manufacturing facility at Bandikui, Rajasthan.

We are specifically looking for an all-rounder who can take ownership of a requirement from customer enquiry and design through manufacturing and final dispatch.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. MMS Design & Engineering**

- Understand customer requirements, layouts, BOQs and technical specifications.

- Develop/review Module Mounting Structure designs for rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects.

- Review structural calculations, loading conditions, wind loads and design assumptions.

- Coordinate preparation of GA drawings, fabrication drawings and BOMs.

- Optimize structures for weight, strength, manufacturability and commercial competitiveness.

- Review material specifications including HDG, pre-galvanized, Galvalume and other steel grades/coatings.

- Coordinate STAAD/structural analysis wherever required.

- Provide technical clarifications to customers, consultants and EPC companies.

**2. Sales & Pre-Sales Support**

- Work directly with the sales team for technical evaluation of enquiries.

- Understand RFQs/tenders and develop suitable technical solutions.

- Prepare BOQs and assist in costing and quotations.

- Participate in technical discussions and negotiations with customers.

- Suggest value-engineered alternatives to improve competitiveness.

- Support the sales team in converting technical enquiries into orders.

- Attend customer meetings whenever required.

**3. Order Execution & Coordination**

Own the technical execution of orders from enquiry to dispatch.

**Coordinate between:**

**Sales → Design → Procurement → Production → Quality → Logistics → Dispatch**

- Ensure correct drawings and BOMs are released to the factory.

- Track production against committed customer timelines.

- Resolve technical issues during production.

- Ensure design revisions are properly communicated and implemented.

- Coordinate urgent/customer-specific requirements with the Bandikui team.

**4. Bandikui Factory Technical Support**

- Act as the primary technical point of contact between Noida HO and the Bandikui manufacturing facility.

- Provide troubleshooting support for roll-forming and related production issues.

- Coordinate resolution of problems involving machines, tooling, profiles, dimensions and production quality.

- Work with machine manufacturers/service teams when required.

- Support development of new profiles and products.

- Visit the Bandikui plant periodically and whenever critical technical intervention is required.

**5. Product Development & Value Engineering**

- Continuously work on reducing structure weight without compromising structural integrity.

- Develop new profiles and mounting solutions based on market requirements.

- Improve designs for faster manufacturing and installation.

- Standardize commonly used profiles, drawings and BOMs.

- Evaluate new materials, coatings and manufacturing methods.

**6. Quality & Technical Documentation**

- Ensure manufactured products conform to approved drawings and specifications.

- Establish/review dimensional tolerances and quality parameters.

- Support root-cause analysis for customer complaints or manufacturing deviations.

- Maintain proper technical documentation, drawings, revisions, BOMs and specifications.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have:

- Degree/Diploma in Mechanical, Civil or Structural Engineering.

- 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in Solar MMS, roll forming, structural steel or related manufacturing.

- Strong understanding of solar Module Mounting Structures.

- Practical understanding of manufacturing and shop-floor challenges.

- Knowledge of roll-forming machines, dies/tooling and profile development will be a major advantage.

- Understanding of structural design and STAAD/structural analysis.

- Ability to understand engineering drawings and BOMs.

- Good commercial understanding and ability to interact confidently with customers.

- Strong coordination and problem-solving skills.

- Willingness to travel to the Bandikui factory and customer/project locations when required.

**Most Important Requirement**

We are not looking for someone restricted to only design, only sales or only production.

We need a hands-on professional who understands the complete cycle:

Customer Requirement → Design → Costing → Order → Manufacturing → Troubleshooting → Quality → Dispatch

The person should be comfortable switching between a customer technical meeting, reviewing a structural design, discussing costing with sales, and resolving a manufacturing or machine-related issue with the factory.

**Reporting**

The position will be based at the Noida Head Office and will work closely with senior management while coordinating extensively with the Bandikui manufacturing team.

**What We Value**

Ownership | Technical Competence | Commercial Understanding | Problem Solving | Speed of Execution | Customer Orientation

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV at:**  
shivani@chemitechgroup.com

title: Senior Solutions Specialist - Presales
description:
### **About Us**


Nucleus Software has been providing Products and Services to various Global and Regional Financial institutions for the past 40 years. As a pioneer software vendor, Nucleus carries deep banking domain expertise and experience on latest technological trends. The platforms developed by Nucleus power the operations of more than 200 financial institutions in 50 countries, supporting multiple business verticals, accessible through mobile and internet channels. These platforms support retail banking, corporate banking, cash management, internet banking, automotive finance and other business areas.  

  

  

Key highlights about Nucleus include:
  

* Entrusted by Global and Regional banks as a preferred partner for their Traditional to Transformative journey
* Driving large Digitalization programs for various banks using Data Science, Cloud, AI/ML, DevOps, RPA based solutions.
* An organization with an “Employee First” outlook
Recognized as a “Great Place to Work “by a global research organization  
* 
  

### **Job Description**


**Role Purpose\-**  

  

  

To support business development efforts by guiding and overseeing the demonstration and delivery of Nucleus’ platforms \& solutions as a part of client sales pitches and provide support in client management at the demo stage.  

  

  

**Areas of Responsibility\-**  

  

  

**Product Demonstration\-**
  

* Participate in sales strategy meetings and offer inputs based on market/competitor information and internal analysis.
* Ensure that support is provided to sales teams during pitches through product demonstrations and presentations that best highlight the product’s features, utility and competitive advantage to potential clients.
* Engage, question, and participate in deep\-dive discussions/ value workshops with customers and/or Sales team for thorough understanding of customers' existing scenarios, business drivers, pain\-points, gaps, competition, core objectives; seek clarity on and understand customers' evaluation processes \& key evaluation criteria.
* Lead and conduct clients demos or workshops for large account pitches and offer inputs based on client requirements and product features.
* Act as a product evangelist and highlight benefits of product features to clients as well as internal teams.
* Conduct GA Sanity Testing after GA release deployed in Pre\-Sales servers.

**RFPs\-**
  

* Thoroughly review the RFP document to understand the client's requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission guidelines.
* Identify key stakeholders and subject matter experts needed for the response.
* Collaborate with technical experts to design a solution that meets the client's needs.
* Ensure the proposed solution aligns with the company's capabilities and strategic goals.
* Draft responses for each section of the RFP, including functional aspects and Executive Summary.
* Use existing content libraries and past proposals to streamline the writing process.
* Ensure that all responses comply with the RFP requirements and guidelines.
* Verify that all mandatory information and documents are included.
* Conduct internal reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
* Edit the content to improve readability and impact.
* Identify potential risks associated with the proposed solution and develop mitigation strategies.
* Document any assumptions and dependencies.
* Perform a final review of the entire RFP response to ensure completeness and quality.
* Prepare for potential presentations, demos or discussions with the client post\-submission.

**Relationship Building\-**
  

* Liaise with client stakeholders and ensure all requirements are gathered in order to structure the product demos and other supporting collaterals
* Engage with prospective clients and industry leaders to understand business challenges and incorporate changes in internal procedures

**Process Improvement\-**
  

* Stay up to date with industry leading best practices and latest trends and offer insights to sales teams as well as product development teams.
* Implement new processes and tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of product demonstrations.

**People Management\-**
  

* Review MIS reports created by Pre\-sales Executives; analyze and provide insights to senior stakeholders as required.
* Manage, mentor and inspire a team and team members including managing performance, goals and development potential, and evaluate potential new talent.
* Provide support to resolve conflict between multiple work streams / groups; provide inputs on goal setting and performance appraisals of team members; identify training needs for associates based on the client requirements.
Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practices across the team; provide support to team members to achieve their knowledge goals and build expertise.  
* 

  

  

### **Requirements**


* Detailed Knowledge of Products and Solutions.
* Good understanding of the target domain/industry.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a customer\-centric approach.
Proven networking and relationship\-building skills to establish and maintain strong connections with customers, partners, and internal teams  
* 

  

  

### **Benefits**


Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.
